configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: The library, the five variants and their tests, with whatever compiler CXX names or the system's default. The tree clangd and the tests read.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: The host tree with debug information, for the debugger; ./build has none.

configurePresets.name: gcc
configurePresets.description: The host tree under GCC, the matrix's second compiler: g++ followed by STRIPSEQ_GCC_SUFFIX. On macOS g++ is Apple clang, so there the preset is disabled until the suffix names a real GCC, such as -16 for Homebrew's g++-16.

configurePresets.name: cross-m4
configurePresets.description: The library alone for a bare-metal Cortex-M4, as scripts/cross-check.sh checks it.

configurePresets.name: cross-m0
configurePresets.description: The library alone for a bare-metal Cortex-M0, as scripts/cross-check.sh checks it.
